description: Get a job's signed result, optionally waiting for it and saving its out files (images, and out.zip unpacked beside it; never over an existing file). Small text files from out.zip are in the result's out_text. result.env says where the job ran (signed by the runner).

save_dir.description: Save the job's out files into this directory, inside an allowed directory.

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds (default 60, max 600).

name: get_result
